purpose: Reproduce the declared Sioux Falls 200-OD and 250-OD Lagrangian P07 and ADMM R2_S computations from frozen modeled inputs.
inputOrigin: Frozen dynamic model outputs from the local GMNS_Plus_Dataset/17_Sioux_Falls benchmark conversion. The public conversion modules identify that immediate dataset. These are modeled node/arc/demand tables, not observed person trajectories.
solverSources: Unchanged public P07 Lagrangian and ADMM R2_S modules from baseline 6ce18b8bea5bf3b9b7caa6ee4c0ff4e701a34a8b.
referencePolicy: Only small final reference metrics are copied. No saved state, reference path pool or reference flow is supplied to the solve.
releaseStatus: Included in the computational release authorized by the maintainer on 2026-10-04. The exact included files and hashes are recorded below; this is not authorization for unrelated local data.

200.scope: Reference values are used only after the fresh computation. No saved state or reference flow initializes the solver.

250.scope: Reference values are used only after the fresh computation. No saved state or reference flow initializes the solver.

upstreamTerms: GMNS Plus publishes an Apache-2.0 repository license and credits TransportationNetworks/TNTP for its converted benchmarks. The TransportationNetworks README specifies academic-research use and source attribution. Both notices are retained; the root MIT software license does not relicense benchmark data.
publicRedistributionReview: These four finite-graph input tables are released as attributed modeled benchmark derivatives for academic reproducibility. The exact upstream GMNS conversion revision has not been recovered: file identity is established by SHA-256 for this release, while provider-snapshot identity and source-to-graph reconstruction remain unverified. That provenance gap is not evidence that the modeled tables contain private or personal observations.
sourceCitation: Transportation Networks for Research Core Team. Transportation Networks for Research. https://github.com/bstabler/TransportationNetworks. Accessed October 4, 2026. GMNS Plus Dataset, HanZhengIntelliTransport / ASU NSF POSE Team, 17_Sioux_Falls conversion.
transformationBoundary: The retained conversion modules describe benchmark ingestion and static-to-time-expanded transformation. This release starts from the frozen dynamic_arc.csv and dynamic_demand.csv for each scale; these modules were not rerun to certify the original upstream snapshot or transformation settings.
excluded: No person trajectories, provider source archive, full original static benchmark snapshot, saved solver state, reference path pool, or reference arc-flow array is included in this selected input release.
